title.en: One-arm pull-up

summary.en: Strict one-arm pull-up in your chosen grip. Heavy weighted pull-ups plus one-arm practice, in 5-week blocks that end with a test day.
summary.nl: Strikte one-arm pull-up in de gekozen grip. Zwaar gewogen trekken plus eenarmig oefenen, in blokken van 5 weken die eindigen met een testdag.

provenance.evidenceNote: The 65-75 % BW threshold, the 20 s hang and 8 s top-hold gates are coach heuristics (Kavadlo, StrongFirst forum, Willoughby), not research. The machine offset of 6.5 kg is the user's estimate ('6-7 kg'). All P-tagged rules are proposals that the user approves one by one (D8).

tagLegend.A: Taken from the artifact or the Todoist task descriptions; executed as written unless the P proposal that supersedes it is approved (D8, C48). Generic load-jump caps do not limit these RULE-mode loads; a step above the generic cap raises warning WE-S2 at WARN severity and is logged (D13, C45). In-session A rules change the remaining sets immediately and can be undone (D14, C46).
tagLegend.P: Proposal by the app design; active only when the user approved it (param approved_<proposalId> = true). Decisions are stored per proposal id; one proposal may switch several rules (C48). Undecided proposals are inactive.
tagLegend.D: Fixed by docs/DECISIONS.md (user decision or canonical resolution); not a program rule from the artifact and not a proposal.
tagLegend.E: Engineering default needed to execute an A rule deterministically; does not change training content.

attemptChecklist.en: Started from a dead hang with the arm fully extended (no kip, no pre-bend)
Bar or fixed handle (no free-hanging ring)

title.en: Lower the session A pin only after a good week

rationale.en: The pin drops 5 lb only when all sets were done and goes back up 5 lb after two failed weeks, instead of dropping every week (about 5 % more load each week).

ifDeclined.en: The pin drops 5 lb after every session A (10 lb after a controlled negative).

title.en: When a week counts as missed

rationale.en: A session counts when at least half its sets were logged; a week counts with 2 of its 3 sessions.

ifDeclined.en: A week is missed only when no session was done in it.

title.en: When session C counts as easy

rationale.en: Easy means every set had 3 or more reps left, or you tapped 'too easy'.

ifDeclined.en: Only a 'too easy' tap counts.

title.en: What counts as progress on a test

rationale.en: Max +1 kg, or weaker-arm hang +2 s, or top hold +1 s, or 5 lb less help, compared with the last valid test.

ifDeclined.en: Any improvement in any of these counts.

title.en: Add weight to sessions A and C during a block

rationale.en: +2.5 kg next week when every set hit its reps with 2 or more left and no grip slip, as in session B.

ifDeclined.en: A and C weights stay the same until the next test.

title.en: Set the session C hang time from your test

rationale.en: Target: 67 % of your weaker arm's test hang, between 10 and 30 s, at most 5 s more per test.

ifDeclined.en: The target stays 10 s; the test summary asks whether to change it.

title.en: Test 5 weeks after the last test

rationale.en: Each block counts 5 weeks from the test you actually did, so a postponed test does not shorten the next block.

ifDeclined.en: Tests follow the fixed dates: 8 Nov and 13 Dec 2026, 17 Jan, 21 Feb, 28 Mar and 2 May 2027.

title.en: Max reps last on test day

rationale.en: A long set of reps tires your grip before the hang and hold tests.

ifDeclined.en: Order: 3RM, max reps, hang, top hold, least help.

title.en: Tests never lower your negatives

rationale.en: Negatives progress on their own; if you did them this block, a test can raise them but not lower them.

ifDeclined.en: Each test sets negatives to 105 % of your max, which can lower them.

title.en: Recalculate loads from your personal rep curve

rationale.en: After a test, the session C, A and B loads come from your own rep curve; each changes at most 5 kg.

ifDeclined.en: Session C keeps its last load; A = C + 2.17 kg and B = C + 6.51 kg, with no limit on the change.

title.en: Set the machine pins from your test

rationale.en: A pin = your weaker arm's test pin + 10 lb, C = A + 10 lb, 90-degree hold = A - 5 lb.

ifDeclined.en: Pins keep following their weekly rules.

title.en: Lighter session B sets after a grind

rationale.en: When a B set falls short or has no reps left, the remaining sets drop 2.5 kg. You can undo it.

ifDeclined.en: No change; you decide.

title.en: More machine help in session A after a failed set

rationale.en: When your weaker arm misses 2 or more reps, the remaining sets get 5 lb more help. You can undo it.

ifDeclined.en: Only the first set adjusts the pin.

title.en: Elbow protocol ends only after 3 pain-free days

rationale.en: Otherwise it runs 7 days longer, with the advice to see a physiotherapist.

ifDeclined.en: The protocol ends after exactly 14 days.

title.en: Longer pauses repeat or restart

rationale.en: After 7 days or more the week repeats with the same loads; after 28 days or more the block restarts at week 1.

ifDeclined.en: Any pause continues the same week with the same loads.

title.en: Either arm completes the challenge

rationale.en: The challenge is one rep, so one valid rep with either arm counts.

ifDeclined.en: You need a valid rep with each arm.

title.en: Three ladders in the ladder version of session B

rationale.en: 3 ladders of 1-2-3 is 18 reps, close to the usual 6 x 2 plus extra singles.

ifDeclined.en: The app asks how many ladders when they start.

title.en: Draft sessions for phases 2 and 3

rationale.en: Rough plans for the later phases, refined with you before you get there.

ifDeclined.en: The phase 1 sessions continue until the program is updated.

title.en: Waiting for a test stays a deload week

rationale.en: When the test is postponed, the waiting week stays light so you test fresh.

ifDeclined.en: Waiting weeks use full sessions.

title.en: 5 s negative right after least help on test day

rationale.en: Keeps it away from the hang and hold tests.

ifDeclined.en: It stays in the same place; the test order is fixed.

title.en: Step-by-step test protocols

rationale.en: Least help: start at the A pin + 10 lb, 5 lb less after each clean rep, up to 5 tries per arm. 3RM: warm up at 50, 70 and 85 %, then +2.5 kg tries, at most 3.

ifDeclined.en: The test only states the goal.

title.en: Plank plate: 5 kg

rationale.en: The program adds 'a plate' without saying which.

ifDeclined.en: The app asks which plate when you get there.

title.en: No curls or heavy grip work for 24 h after session B

rationale.en: Session B is the hardest session for your elbows.

ifDeclined.en: No rest window after session B.

title.en: Back to 6 x 2 after progress

rationale.en: Ladders fix a stall; once a test shows progress, session B returns to 6 x 2.

ifDeclined.en: Session B stays on ladders until you change it.

title.en: What counts as a normal session

rationale.en: Session A, B or C with at least 80 % of its sets logged and no pain report.

ifDeclined.en: Any finished A, B or C session without a pain report.

title.en: A fixed day for the weekly hang measurement

rationale.en: Measure your best two-arm hang fresh once a week on a set day (Monday unless you pick another).

ifDeclined.en: You pick the day each week.

title.en: Light training during the elbow protocol

rationale.en: Bodyweight pull-ups, rows and dips with 3 or more reps left, half the sets, double prehab.

ifDeclined.en: One-arm and negative work is removed; the rest keeps its loads with a 'keep it light' note.

title.en: Pallof press: one step heavier when clearly easy

rationale.en: "Clearly easier" read as 4 or more reps left on every set; then one stack step more next time.

ifDeclined.en: The Pallof press keeps its load until you change it.

title.en: A lighter week after the elbow protocol

rationale.en: Before the restored loads: an extra deload week with 10 lb more assistance, 5 kg less on the belt and no negatives.

ifDeclined.en: The restored loads apply straight after the protocol.

The same regex is used by the DATA_MODEL calendar_events.marker CHECK, the ANDROID parser, UX and ALGORITHMS_PLANNING. The engine, not the definition, renders and parses the marker; this string documents it. Edit policy (owner ANDROID.md 16.7): user time edits win; a user-edited title or description stops app updates for that event; the app deletes only its own unmodified future events; user deletions are respected.

rules.if: sess.slot == 'A' && mode == 'normal' && !s.pinAReportShown && valid('oaa') && last(ex.oaa.pin) <= p.pinAReportLb && count(ex.oaa.reps) >= ex.oaa.plannedRows && all(ex.oaa.reps >= ex.oaa.targetReps)

explain.en: 5 x 3 per arm at 35 lb or less: you are stronger than the 30 Aug test showed.
No normal session since the break: today is a light session B, and the test moves to the first Sunday after a normal session.

rules.if: sess.slot in ['A', 'B', 'C'] && mode != 'injury' && !sess.painReported && (p.approved_P25 ? sess.completionRatio >= p.cleanSessionRatio : true)

explain.en: A normal session without pain: the test can go ahead.

rules.source: artifact section 01 / section 10 ('een gewone sessie zonder klachten')

explain.en: Valid test: the next block starts Monday with new loads.
Two tests without progress: check sleep and food first. Still none: session B switches to 1-2-3 ladders and an extra deload week is added.
Progress again: session B returns to 6 x 2.
All goals met: next phase (or the challenge is done).

rules.source: artifact section 03 / section 10 ('ongeacht in welke week je zit')

explain.en: New block: week 1 (or an extra deload week first).
Week closed: move on, repeat with the same loads, or wait for the test.
Week 5 of the block: deload (half the sets, same loads), test on Sunday.
A planned test date falls in this week: deload, test on Sunday.
Back after a break: same week, same loads; the test waits for one normal session without pain.

rules.source: artifact section 10 ('Bij een gemiste week ... Na een onderbreking schuift een testdag door')

explain.en: Away {gapDays} days: this week repeats with the same loads; the test waits for one normal session.
Away {gapDays} days: the block restarts at week 1 with its starting loads.
The hand slipped before the last rep: no weight added this time (grip, not strength).

rules.source: artifact section 05 / Todoist A and B

rules.if: sess.slot == 'B' && mode == 'normal' && s.bVariant == '6x2' && valid('wpu') && count(ex.wpu.reps) >= ex.wpu.plannedRows && all(ex.wpu.reps >= ex.wpu.targetReps) && min(ex.wpu.rir) >= p.bMinRir

explain.en: All 5 x 2 with at least 2 reps in reserve: +2.5 kg next week.
Negatives lasted 8 s again: +5 kg.

rules.allowInFrozenNote: E: protective step back (easier); deload 'keep the weight' does not block a failure-driven reset.

explain.en: A negative under 5 s or jerky: back to {negReset} kg.

rules.if: p.approved_P09 && sess.slot == 'B' && mode == 'normal' && valid('neg') && min(ex.neg.ecc_s) >= p.negUpEccS && !any(ex.neg.jerky)

explain.en: The reset weight moves up with the negatives (+5 kg).
Session A: -5 lb on the pin every week (-10 lb after a controlled negative).

rules.allowInFrozenNote: E: the harder branch is guarded by mode == 'normal'; only the protective +5 lb branch can act in frozen modes.

explain.en: All 5 x 3 per arm done: -5 lb (-10 lb after a controlled negative). Missed reps: same pin; two failed weeks in a row: +5 lb.
90-degree hold: -5 lb every week (from the pin you finished on).

rules.source: artifact section 06 / Todoist A ('Lukt het niet, 5 lbs erbij. Elke week 5 lbs eraf.')

rules.if: sess.slot == 'A' && valid('sth') && s.sthS < p.sthTargetS && count(ex.sth.hold_s) >= ex.sth.plannedRows && all(ex.sth.hold_s >= s.sthS) && !any(ex.sth.torso_rotation)

explain.en: All four straight-arm holds clean at 6 s: next time 8 s.
Two easy C sessions in a row: -5 lb.

rules.allowInFrozenNote: E: protective step back (more assistance) is allowed in frozen modes.

explain.en: Fewer than 4 reps in a set: +5 lb assistance next time.

rules.source: Todoist C ('kom je onder de vier reps, 5 lbs erbij')

explain.en: All six plank sets clean on both home days: 20 s, then 30 s, then a plate on your upper back.

rules.source: Todoist Core / B; two days since the Pallof press replaced B's plank (D40)

rules.if: p.approved_P28 && mode == 'normal' && valid('pallof') && count(ex.pallof.reps) >= ex.pallof.plannedRows && all(ex.pallof.reps >= ex.pallof.targetReps) && min(ex.pallof.rir) >= p.pallofMinRirUp

explain.en: Every Pallof set with 4 or more reps left: one stack step heavier next time.

rules.source: proposal P28 (Todoist: 'clearly easier: one step heavier')

rules.if: p.approved_P05 && sess.slot == 'A' && mode == 'normal' && valid('wpu') && count(ex.wpu.reps) >= ex.wpu.plannedRows && all(ex.wpu.reps >= ex.wpu.targetReps) && min(ex.wpu.rir) >= p.inBlockMinRir

explain.en: All 4 x 4 with at least 2 reps in reserve: +2.5 kg next week.

rules.if: p.approved_P05 && sess.slot == 'C' && mode == 'normal' && valid('wpu') && count(ex.wpu.reps) >= ex.wpu.plannedRows && all(ex.wpu.reps >= ex.wpu.targetReps) && min(ex.wpu.rir) >= p.inBlockMinRir

explain.en: All 4 x 5 with at least 2 reps in reserve: +2.5 kg next week.

rules.if: p.approved_P18 && phase >= 2 && sess.slot == 'A' && mode == 'normal' && s.pinA == 0lb && valid('oaa') && count(ex.oaa.reps) >= ex.oaa.plannedRows && all(ex.oaa.reps >= ex.oaa.targetReps)

explain.en: All sets done with {fingerLevel} fingers: one finger fewer next week.

rules.source: proposal P18 (artifact section 03 phase 2: four, three, two, one finger)

elbow_protocol.en: Stop. Elbow protocol for 14 days: no one-arm work, light two-arm training, double prehab, no daily hang. If it persists, see a professional.

back_to_two_blocks_ago.en: Elbow protocol over. Loads go back to two blocks ago; a new block starts Monday.

reentry_week.en: Elbow protocol over. First a lighter week: half the sets, 10 lb more assistance, 5 kg less on the belt, no negatives. Then the loads of two blocks ago.

pain_persists_physio.en: Still pain: the protocol runs one more week. Consider a physiotherapist.

test_recorded.en: Test recorded. New loads apply from Monday.

test_postponed.en: Test postponed until after one normal session without pain. Today is a light session B.

test_still_pending.en: The test is still to come; this week stays a deload week.

missed_week_no_makeup.en: Missed week: nothing to make up, same loads.

resume_same_week.en: Welcome back. Same week, same loads; the test waits for one normal session without pain.

resume_repeat.en: Welcome back. This week repeats with the same loads; the test waits for one normal session without pain.

resume_restart.en: Welcome back. The block restarts at week 1 with its starting loads.

grip_not_strength.en: Hand slipped before the last rep: no weight added (grip, not strength).

grip_slip_stop.en: Hand slipped: end the set here.

stall_sleep_food.en: Two tests without progress. Don't train harder: check sleep (8 h) and protein first.

stall_ladders.en: Still no progress: session B switches to 1-2-3 ladders and an extra deload week follows the test.

dead_start_unlocked.en: Your one-arm hang is above 15 s: dead-hang starts can come back in a later program update.

pin_report_baseline.en: 5 x 3 per arm at 35 lb or less: you are stronger than your 30 Aug test showed.

plank_plate.en: Plank: next step is a plate on your upper back.

plank_plate_choose.en: Plank: all sets clean at 30 s. Which plate do you want on your upper back?

calibration_adjust.en: Calibration set: pin {value} for the remaining sets.

oaa_fail_up.en: Two or more reps short: +5 lb help for the remaining sets.

h90_fail_up.en: Hold under 6 s: +5 lb on the pin for the remaining rounds.

b_grind_down.en: That set was a grind: -2.5 kg for the remaining sets.

rotation_stop_set.en: Torso rotated: end the set here.

rotation_stop_scap_right.en: Torso rotated: end the set here. Nothing carries over to the next set.

rotation_stop_hang.en: Torso rotated: the clock stops here. Log the time up to the rotation.

rotation_stop_sth.en: Torso rotated: end the hold here. The hold time does not go up after this session.

hip_stop.en: Hip tilted: the set stops here.

fields.name: vars
fields.note: Any state var by name; missing vars use their init expression.

fields.name: pastTests
fields.note: Each: date, metrics, validForGate, comparable flags per metric, protocol codes, notes. C59: historical tests are imported as metric observations with validity flags only; no historical set rows are created, so RCM-1 (and the D7 gate) uses the class prior k = 30 until it has informative windows. A value recorded without an arm (the 2026-08-30 least assistance, oa_least_assist_kg 22.5) is imported for both arms.

fields.name: blockItemCounts
fields.note: Valid sessions per item key already done in the imported (current) block before cutover, for example { "neg": 4 }. Added to validInBlock() for that block only, so P09 sees the negatives done before the app took over.

fields.name: importedTestHandling
fields.note: For a test done before cutover: historyOnly when the chat workflow already recalculated the loads (import those loads as vars); recalculate to replay it as test.completed so the app's rules run.

1.0.0.notes: Text only (D35), the structured test protocols of P21 (D36) and the first-test rules (D37). No state var changes.

1.0.1.notes: Structured test protocols of P21 (D36) and the first-test rules (D37). No state var changes.

1.1.0.notes: D37: the first valid test fills empty loads, negatives and pins; the gate e1RM is initialised from the entered 3RM. Nothing changes once every value is set.

1.2.0.notes: D38: the test may fall on any day (a rest day before it stays required) and goes first in its week while there are no loads.

1.3.0.notes: D40: the Pallof press in A, B and C (B's gym plank removed, the plank rule counts the two home days), P28 and P29 (re-entry week after the elbow protocol). New vars pallofKg and reentry start from their init.

1.4.0.notes: D44: no rowing machine in the warm-up (wu_row and the rower_erg equipment and exercise removed). No state var changes.

1.5.0.notes: D45: the elbow trace also fires on pain at the back of the elbow and in the forearm (new body regions); the Pallof press is per side. No state var changes.

1.6.0.notes: D47: prehab keeps its sets in deload, test_pending and extra_deload weeks (only warm-ups were exempt from the halving). No state var changes.

1.7.0.notes: D51: the daily two-arm hang is skipped on every gym day (A, B, C and the test day), not only on A. No state var changes.

1.8.0.notes: D52: the torso-rotation notice says what it means for each exercise (one in-session rule per item instead of one for every item). No state var changes.

1.9.0.notes: D63: in a re-entry week the protective pin rules (prog.A.pin.gated, prog.C.pin.hard) take the logged pin minus the re-entry offset as their base, so the offset never reaches s.pinA or s.pinC. No state var changes.

1.10.0.notes: D90: the three prehab items (reverse wrist curls, pronation-supination, face pulls) are delegated to RX-1 with rep ranges and a target RIR (3, 3, 2), so their load progresses from the exercise's own history; creditRir follows the target. No state var changes.

1.11.0.notes: D117: shorter A and B sessions (about a quarter less) and a lighter C: fewer accessory sets (A top hold 2 rounds, 90-degree and straight-arm holds 2 sets; B negatives 2 sets, row 3 sets; Pallof press 2 sets everywhere), a small cut in the main work (A assisted one-arm 4 sets, B weighted pull-ups 5 x 2) and shorter rests on lighter work; prehab rests 30 s. prog.A.sth counts the planned rows instead of a fixed six. No state var changes.
